name: Y Strainer DN80 Flanged PN16
description: High-detail industrial flanged Y-strainer DN80 PN16 in ductile iron with electrostatic blue epoxy coating, precision 45-degree filtration leg, 8-bolt EN 1092-2 flanges with raised faces, bolted bonnet cover, hexagonal fasteners, central brass blow-off drain plug, cast reinforcing rib, and directional flow arrow.
